## Multitasking from one edge gesture
Switch apps, open floating windows, and run system actions without leaving what is already on screen.

screenshots.accessibilityText: A floating app window beside the alphabetical app launcher and keyboard
Myrtle's semicircular edge selector with apps and system actions
A pinned video window above the alphabetical app launcher
A windowed social app opened over another app
Floating windows and keyboard support in landscape orientation

views.markdown:
- Lightweight One-window mode, plus optional Multi-window mode
- Favorite apps, recent apps, alphabetical launcher, Shortcuts, URLs, and system actions
- Snap, pin, resize, rotate, and switch apps inside a floating window
- Keyboard support and a compact 16:9 layout
- Open notifications, universal links, shared files, and AirDrop destinations in a window

For full details and purchase information, please visit the [official website](https://m4fn3.github.io/repo/web/Myrtle.html).

## 1.4.1 - 2026-07-30
- Added Quick Reverse center-button style.
- Added an option to keep windows inside the screen while moving them.
- Fixed snapping sometimes remaining disabled until respring.

## 1.4.0 - 2026-05-09
- Added an alphabetical app launcher with vertical letter selection and horizontal app selection.
- Added configurable tap and long-press actions for the edge handle.

## 1.3.7 - 2026-05-02
- Added a cellular data toggle action.
- Improved frontmost-app detection and transitions involving normal, fullscreen, and pinned windows.

## 1.3.6 - 2026-04-18
- Fixed the volume slider resetting after respring.
- Fixed snapping, cold-start, and reload regressions introduced with the new window animations.

## 1.3.5 - 2026-04-11
- Fixed a random SpringBoard crash when opening apps.
- Fixed the animation switch and snapping during splash animations.

## 1.3.4 - 2026-04-11
- Added customizable selector icon sizes.
- Added brightness and volume slider actions.
- Added an action for opening Snapper 3 history and improved window animations.

## 1.3.3 - 2026-04-05
- Added configurable ring radius, ring spacing, and uniform icon sizing.
- Added options to keep windows through rotation and preserve pinned windows after unlock.

## 1.3.2 - 2026-04-03
- Added independent pinning in One-window mode, allowing up to two windows on screen.
- Improved launch animations and fixed keyboard, lock-screen URL, and Control Center issues.

## 1.3.1 - 2026-03-12
- Added fullscreen and clipboard translation actions for HammerIt and TransLux.
- Added clipboard-history actions for CopyLog, Kayoko, and CopyVault.
- Improved window animations and fixed blank-screen and maximum-size issues.

## 1.3.0 - 2026-03-07
- Added keyboard support when the app or device uses landscape orientation. Some cases require MyrtleSupport injection.
- Expanded third-party keyboard haptics and fixed keyboard flicker while switching apps.
- Improved selector animation and handle previews, with an option to use legacy highlighting.

## 1.2.6 - 2026-02-28
- Added haptics for supported third-party keyboards through MyrtleSupport injection.
- Improved notification closing, iOS 15 theme changes, and portrait/landscape app switching.
- Added an external API for other tweaks to open Myrtle windows.

## 1.2.5 - 2026-02-25
- Improved dynamic resizing and launch-time window positioning.
- Updated the universal-link blacklist to block transitions in both directions.
- Added live theme adaptation while windows are closed and a Return-key option for the app launcher.

## 1.2.4 - 2026-02-24
- Added native Shortcuts support and customizable action glyphs. Existing Shortcuts must be removed and added again.
- Added higher frame-rate support and exclusion areas for tap-outside actions.
- Fixed launch crashes and handle placement around the keyboard and Lock Screen.

## 1.2.3 - 2026-02-22
- Fixed v1.2.2 regressions involving landscape cold starts, black screens, and keyboard avoidance.
- Excluded the call interface from recent apps and improved fullscreen/window orientation switching.

## 1.2.2 - 2026-02-22
- Added proper app launch animations and a fourth selector ring.
- Added a reload-window action and more tap-outside choices.
- Fixed cold-start snapping, resizing, keyboard avoidance, and iOS 15 landscape behavior.

## 1.2.1 - 2026-02-21
- Fixed a crash when tap-outside actions were enabled without gestures on both sides.

## 1.2.0 - 2026-02-21
- Added configurable actions for tapping outside a window: do nothing, close, or snap.
- Improved landscape adaptation, safe areas, handle positioning, and app-launcher keyboard avoidance.
- Added an option to hide the handle on the Lock Screen.

## 1.1.7 - 2026-02-20
- Fixed landscape keyboard overlap, iOS 15 rotation, and a universal-link auto-close crash.
- Fixed screen-capture hiding behavior and added support for cold-starting landscape apps.

## 1.1.6 - 2026-02-19
- Added an option to remember window position and size in supported layouts.
- Updated swipe-up behavior to restore a moved window to its default snapped position first.

## 1.1.5 - 2026-02-16
- Fixed layout issues when opening a 16:9 windowed app in fullscreen.
- Fixed a small gap at the default position after swiping down.

## 1.1.4 - 2026-02-15
- Added animations when opening the selector, selecting apps, and triggering center-hold.
- Fixed some apps being interrupted while switching the fullscreen app.

## 1.1.3 - 2026-02-14
- Improved keyboard responsiveness and recent-app tracking for windowed apps.
- Improved app-launcher keyboard opening, Return-key selection, and result sorting.
- Reorganized preference items.

## 1.1.2 - 2026-02-13
- Added adaptive keyboard height for 16:9 and snapped windows.
- Added Smart Notification Opening.
- Improved selector visibility and added Rotation Lock, Dark/Light Mode, Wi-Fi, and Location Services actions.

## 1.1.1 - 2026-02-12
- Added actions to swap fullscreen/windowed apps and terminate background or Now Playing apps.
- Improved Lock Screen, notification, Snapper-delay, and toast behavior.

## 1.1.0 - 2026-02-10
- Added optional sound feedback.
- Refreshed app-library design and colors.
- Adjusted iOS 15 support, including partial 16:9 support.

## 1.0.7 - 2026-02-07
- Improved light-mode appearance, edge-swipe recognition, and camera behavior in windowed apps.
- Added haptic/toast controls, live toggle states in the selector, and accidental-fast-swipe protection.

## 1.0.6 - 2026-02-06
- Fixed 16:9 support on iOS 15.
- Fixed notifications and universal-link integration on iOS 15 and iOS 16.0.x.

## 1.0.5 - 2026-02-05
- Added optional gestures on both screen edges and automatic handle-side adaptation.
- Added controls for handle movement, window corner radius, and selector distance.
- Added delayed screenshots when capture hiding is disabled.

## 1.0.4 - 2026-02-04
- Added automatic handle hiding after inactivity.
- Added configurable handle height, gesture area, and transparency.

## 1.0.3 - 2026-02-03
- Improved window-opening behavior, authorization handling, corner rounding, and fullscreen transitions.
- Added direct window movement and resizing.

## 1.0.2 - 2026-02-01
- Added VPN, flashlight, and respring actions.
- Added native RootHide support and improved universal-link and iOS 17 notification handling.
- Improved app cleanup and automatic window closing.

## 1.0.1 - 2026-01-31
- Improved performance and reduced memory usage.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-01-30
- Initial release.
